dishes.make_ahead: Slice the salami and kabana and cut the pickles up to 4 hours ahead, covered in the fridge; slice the rye just before serving

steps.text: Slice the salami and the kabana and lay them out on a big board.
Add the dill pickles cut into spears, the cream cheese in a bowl and a sliced dark rye loaf, the way Magda would set out a New Year's Eve spread.

veg.n: Magda's continental platter with marinated artichokes
veg.make_ahead: Drain the artichokes and slice the smoked tofu up to 1 day ahead, chilled; cut the pickles and slice the rye just before serving

steps.text: Drain the marinated artichokes, slice the smoked tofu thinly and lay them out on a big board.
Add the dill pickles cut into spears, the cream cheese in a bowl and a sliced dark rye loaf, the way Magda would set out a New Year's Eve spread.

dishes.make_ahead: Mash the egg filling up to 1 day ahead and keep chilled; spread, trim and cut the sandwiches within 2 hours of serving

steps.text: Boil the eggs for 10 minutes, cool, peel and mash with the mayonnaise, salt and pepper.
Spread over the white bread, scatter with cress and top with more slices.
Trim the crusts and cut into fingers.

dishes.make_ahead: Make the paprikash up to 2 days ahead without the sour cream and keep chilled; reheat, stir the sour cream through and cook the noodles fresh

steps.text: Brown the chicken thighs, then soften the onions and the red capsicum in the pan.
Stir in the sweet paprika, add the chicken stock and the chicken, and simmer 30 minutes.
Cook the egg noodles and toss with the butter. Stir the sour cream through the paprikash off the heat and serve over the buttered noodles.

veg.make_ahead: Make the mushroom paprikash up to 2 days ahead without the sour cream and keep chilled; reheat, stir the sour cream through and cook the noodles fresh

steps.text: Brown the mushrooms in the oil in batches, then soften the onions and the red capsicum in the pan.
Stir in the sweet paprika, add the vegetable stock and the mushrooms, and simmer 15 minutes.
Cook the egg noodles and toss with the butter.
Stir the sour cream through off the heat and serve over the buttered egg noodles.

dishes.make_ahead: Bake the loaf up to 2 days ahead and wrap once cool; ice it the day you serve

steps.text: Beat the butter with the sugar, add the eggs and the zest of the lemons, then fold in the self-raising flour, the poppy seeds and the milk.
Bake in a loaf tin at 170C for 50 minutes.
Ice with the icing sugar mixed with lemon juice.

dishes.n: Magda's New Year's Eve champagne punch
dishes.make_ahead: Mix the brandy, peach liqueur, orange juice and peaches and chill up to 1 day ahead; add the ice, sparkling wine and soda water just before serving

steps.text: In a large punch bowl, mix the brandy, the peach liqueur, the fresh orange juice and the sliced ripe peaches.
Chill 1 hour.
Just before serving add a big block of ice and pour in the chilled bottle of sparkling wine and the soda water.
Stir once gently.
Ladle into coupes with a slice of peach in.
For non-drinkers, use peach nectar and sparkling apple juice.

af.n: Magda's New Year's Eve peach punch
af.make_ahead: Mix the vanilla, peach nectar, orange juice and peaches and chill up to 1 day ahead; add the ice, alcohol-free sparkling wine and soda water just before serving

steps.text: In a large punch bowl, mix the vanilla, peach nectar, orange juice and the sliced peaches.
Chill 1 hour.
Just before serving add a big block of ice and pour in the chilled alcohol-free sparkling wine and the soda water.
Stir once gently.
Ladle into coupes with a slice of peach in each.
